method: Imported the GEDCOM into a fresh isolated GRAMPSHOME, exported a native Gramps file, then ran the installed add-on report from that file.

visual_review.margins: The content appears consistent with the renderer's configured 15 mm margins; this was a visual review, not a coordinate measurement.

scope: These CLI results use fictional data and no media. The HTML ZIP received archive integrity, unique-ID, and local-link checks but was not opened interactively in a browser. The results do not validate the GUI flow, PDF/UA conformance, screen-reader behavior, or other Gramps versions.
